changeSet.author: fineract
changeSet.comment: Convert Client Saving Transactions report from Pentaho to Table type with SQL query

column.name: report_sql
column.value: SELECT t.id AS "Transaction ID", t.transaction_date AS "Date", CASE t.transaction_type_enum WHEN 1 THEN 'Deposit' WHEN 2 THEN 'Withdrawal' WHEN 3 THEN 'Interest Posting' WHEN 4 THEN 'Withdrawal Fee' WHEN 5 THEN 'Annual Fee' WHEN 6 THEN 'Waive Charges' WHEN 7 THEN 'Pay Charge' WHEN 8 THEN 'Dividend Payout' WHEN 20 THEN 'Amount Hold' WHEN 21 THEN 'Amount Release' ELSE 'Other' END AS "Type", t.amount AS "Amount", t.running_balance_derived AS "Balance", t.is_reversed AS "Reversed" FROM m_savings_account_transaction t JOIN m_savings_account sa ON sa.id = t.savings_account_id WHERE sa.account_no = '${savingsAccountId}' AND t.transaction_date BETWEEN '${startDate}' AND '${endDate}' AND t.is_reversed = false ORDER BY t.transaction_date DESC, t.id DESC
